key.name: last-action
key.description: Action id shown first when the power menu opens.

key.name: shortcut-keysym
key.description: X11 key symbol of the shortcut. The default is F4.

key.name: shortcut-mods
key.description: Shift=1, Control=2, Alt=4, Super=8. The default is Alt.

key.name: visible-actions
key.description: Action IDs that appear in the power menu.

key.name: action-order
key.description: Order of actions in the power menu and preferences.
